mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at 37 degrees near the Military Ridge State Trail and the waxing crescent moon is rising. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds. We are looking at an overnight low of 30 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

In city updates, the Plan Commission is preparing for their December 7th meeting where they will review several pending projects, including the Sub-Zero site plan and architectural designs. Additionally, the Municipal Court reminds residents that they can handle traffic citations online or by phone, though O W I tickets still require a court appearance or discussion with the city attorney.

There is plenty to do in Verona! Today you can enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness or catch the Thursday night festivities at ART House 360. Also, don't miss out on Hop Haus trivia happening today, followed by live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee tomorrow.
Looking at the police report, on October 23, officers made contact with two juveniles riding prohibited eMotos on Ashton Drive, resulting in citations for their parents.
It is a great day to visit Culver's for today's flavor, which is Devil's Food Cake. The restaurant is currently open and will remain open until 10:00 PM tonight.
